text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['f02'] == 'tcp') | ((df['f20'] == 0) & (df['f23'] == 0) & (df['f21'] == 0) & (df['f22'] == 0) & (df['f24'] == 0) & (df['f25'] == 0) & (df['f26'] == 0))"],"features":["f02","f20","f23","f21","f22","f24","f25","f26"],"rationale":"TCP window advertisements, base sequence numbers, and TCP connection setup timings are not applicable to non-TCP flows."},{"id":"R2","category":"protocol","alternatives":["df['f03'].isin(['http', 'ftp', 'ftp-data', 'smtp', 'ssh', 'dns', 'irc', '-']) | ((df['f29'] == 0) & (df['f30'] == 0))"],"features":["f03","f29","f30"],"rationale":"Pipelined HTTP transaction depth and HTTP response content size are inapplicable when the service is identified as a non-HTTP service."},{"id":"R3","category":"protocol","alternatives":["df['f03'].isin(['ftp', 'ftp-data', '-']) | (df['f37'] == 0)"],"features":["f03","f37"],"rationale":"An identified non-FTP service cannot have an FTP login session."}]}
